name: call_library_vector_and_store
description: Saves two register-supplied values into a structure, then calls a library function and stores its return value in that structure. If the return value is zero it calls a second library routine; otherwise it copies the saved values into two global variables.

name: copy_two_longs_into_globals
description: Copies two 32-bit values from fields of a structure addressed by the A2 register into two global variables and returns. The pseudo-code makes no other calls.

name: stub_single_instruction_routine
description: The decompiler shows only one instruction, which cannot be recovered as behaviour. It is a one-instruction routine reached through the library vector table and the global copy path.

name: stub_library_vector_entry
description: The decompiler shows only one instruction with no recoverable behaviour. The routine is an entry point taken by several library vector slots.

name: call_handler_then_return
description: Calls one other routine and then returns. No other work is visible in the pseudo-code, and the callee is not named in the executable.

name: store_arg_into_returned_record
description: Calls a library function through a function pointer read from the first argument's structure, passing that argument. It then stores the second argument into the record the call returns.

name: chain_calls_release_on_failure
description: Calls a routine with the last two arguments and, if it returns a nonzero value, passes that value to a second routine with the first two arguments. If the second call returns zero it calls a third routine to release the value and returns zero; otherwise it returns the first value.

name: copy_stack_block_into_record
description: Looks up a record, then fills a stack buffer from a second structure and, if that succeeds, copies eleven longwords and several fields from the buffer into the record. If the record links to another structure, it stores the record there before returning it; if the second step fails, it calls a cleanup routine and returns zero.

name: copy_saved_block_into_record
description: Copies eleven longwords and several fields from a block saved in the stack frame into a record. It then stores the record into a field of the structure that the record's link field points to, if that link is set.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns zero with no other work. It is a stub that reports failure to its callers.

name: pack_record_into_stack_block
description: Copies eleven longwords and several fields from a record into a stack buffer that starts with a fixed two-word header. It then passes that buffer with the two leading arguments to a library routine.

name: load_info_icon_file
description: Opens a file whose name uses the .info suffix and checks its header for a fixed signature and version. If both match, it allocates memory for the icon's image sections and reads them in; otherwise it cleans up and returns zero.

name: validate_and_read_icon_body
description: Checks an icon header for a fixed signature and version, then clears fields and reads the icon's image sections. It allocates memory for each section it reads and returns one when every section loads, or zero when a read or allocation fails.

name: read_optional_icon_sections
description: Reads two values and then loads optional icon sections through a library function pointer. Each present section is allocated and filled from a table of entries, and the routine returns one on success or zero when a read or allocation fails.

name: read_longword_entry_table
description: Reads four-byte entries through a library function pointer into a table until a counter in the stack frame drops below its threshold. If a further pointer field is set, it reads one more pointer value, and it returns one on success or zero when any read fails.

name: call_helper_then_return_zero
description: Calls one other routine, ignores its result, and returns zero.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without any work, so it is an empty routine.

name: transfer_icon_sections_via_scratch
description: Allocates a 260-byte scratch buffer and runs a sequence of library calls that transfer an icon's header and its string and table sections. The buffer is released before returning, and the routine returns one on success or zero when any allocation or transfer fails.

name: save_optional_icon_sections
description: Writes optional sections of an icon through a library function pointer, computing each string's length plus one and writing that size before the data. It restores a saved field at the end and returns one on success or zero when a write fails.

name: save_icon_string_sections
description: Writes an icon's optional string sections in order, each preceded by its length plus one. It restores a saved field before returning and returns one only when every section write succeeds.

name: count_then_write_string_table
description: Measures a null-terminated table of string pointers by stepping through it, then writes each string preceded by its length plus one. It restores a saved field and returns one on success or zero when a write fails.

name: write_string_pointer_table
description: Writes each string in a null-terminated table of string pointers, each preceded by its length plus one, and then writes one optional trailing section. It restores a saved field and returns one on success or zero on failure.

name: release_list_nodes_until_head
description: Repeatedly takes the next node from a list held in the structure and releases it until no node is returned or the list head is reached again. It then releases any node still held.

name: release_list_nodes_from_pointer
description: Walks a linked list from a starting node, passing each node to a release routine, and stops when the next pointer is empty or returns to the list head. It releases the final node if one remains.

name: call_routine_on_subrecord
description: Passes the first argument and the address of a sub-record inside the second argument to another routine, then returns. It is a thin wrapper with no other work.

name: allocate_record_and_initialise
description: Allocates a 168-byte record and initialises a sub-record inside it through a library call. It returns the record if that step succeeds, and otherwise releases the record and returns zero.

name: call_helper_then_return
description: Calls one other routine and then returns. The pseudo-code shows no other work, and the callee is not named in the executable.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns zero with no other work. It is a stub that reports failure to its callers.

name: store_pair_in_slot_table
description: Takes a slot counter from the first word of a structure and decrements it, calling a refill routine when the counter runs out. It then stores two arguments as an 8-byte pair in the slot it selects, returning one on success or zero when refill fails.

name: store_pair_without_refill
description: Decrements the slot counter in a structure and stores two register values as an 8-byte pair in the slot it selects. It returns one with no refill check.

name: allocate_record_with_subrecord
description: Allocates a 94-byte record and initialises its sub-record through library calls, then runs a second step and returns the record on success. If an early step fails it releases the record, and if the second step fails it releases the sub-record; either way it returns zero.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without any work, so it is an empty routine.

name: call_helper_return_zero
description: Calls one other routine, ignores its result, and returns zero.

name: forward_subrecord_to_routine
description: Passes the first argument and the address of a sub-record at a fixed offset inside the second argument to another routine, then returns. It is a thin wrapper with no other work.

name: find_tooltype_value_in_list
description: Walks a null-terminated list of tool-type names and tests each one with a helper routine. When an entry matches and is followed by an equals sign, it returns a pointer to the text after that sign, or null if nothing matches.

name: scan_tooltype_array_for_value
description: Scans an array of tool-type strings until it reaches an empty entry. It returns a pointer to the text after the equals sign for the first entry whose name test passes, or null when no entry matches.

name: search_string_array_for_value
description: Walks a null-terminated array of pointers, testing each string with a helper routine. It returns a pointer to the text after the equals sign once a test passes and that string holds an equals sign, or null at the end of the array.

name: match_pipe_separated_tooltype
description: Splits a bar-separated list of tool types into tokens and, for each token whose length equals that of the search key, calls a comparison routine. It returns one when a token compares equal and zero when the list is exhausted.

name: find_matching_tooltype_token
description: Steps through bar-separated tool-type tokens, measuring each one and comparing its length with an expected length through a helper. It returns one when a token passes the comparison and zero when no token does.

name: scan_tooltype_tokens_for_match
description: Walks a bar-separated list of tool types, comparing each token's length with an expected value and then running a check on matching tokens. It returns one when a match is confirmed and zero when the list ends.

name: find_tooltype_token_of_length
description: Steps through bar-separated tool-type tokens and returns one when a token has the expected length and passes a check routine. It returns zero when no token matches.

name: test_tooltype_tokens_for_length
description: Walks bar-separated tool-type tokens and returns one when a token with the expected length passes a check routine. It returns zero when the list ends without a match.

name: parse_copy_prefix_into_record
description: Checks a string for an optional copy prefix and reads a decimal count from it digit by digit when one is present. It stores the count and the remaining name text in the record and returns the record.

name: parse_decimal_count_then_cleanup
description: Reads decimal digits from a string after a fixed prefix, using a helper that returns a negative value at the first non-digit. It then runs two cleanup routines and returns with no value.

name: parse_decimal_digits_then_cleanup
description: Reads decimal digits from a string until a non-digit is reached, then checks any remaining suffix through a helper. It runs two cleanup routines before returning with no value.

name: parse_decimal_count_with_suffix
description: Accumulates decimal digits from a string into a count, then checks the text that follows through a helper when the count is nonzero. It runs two cleanup routines and returns with no value.

name: convert_char_to_digit
description: Returns the numeric value of a character if it is an ASCII decimal digit, or minus one for any other character.

name: return_minus_one_stub
description: Returns minus one with no other work. It is a stub that signals failure to its callers.

name: call_library_vector_on_global_base
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at a fixed vector offset through it, then returns. The result of that call is ignored.

name: chain_calls_release_on_failure
description: Calls a routine with the last two arguments and, if it returns a nonzero value, passes that value to a second routine with the first two arguments. If the second call returns zero it calls a third routine to release the value and returns zero; otherwise it returns the first value.

name: allocate_record_and_set_limit
description: Allocates a cleared 96-byte record, stores the value ten in a field of it and in a word the caller supplies, then passes the record to a second routine. It returns one when the allocation succeeded and zero otherwise.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns zero with no other work. It is a stub that reports failure to its callers.

name: check_call_result_matches_argument
description: Calls another routine with three arguments and returns its result when that result equals the fourth argument. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: verify_call_returns_expected_value
description: Calls another routine with three arguments and returns its result only when it equals the fourth argument, returning zero for any other result.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without any work, so it is an empty routine.

name: divide_unsigned_32_bit
description: Computes an unsigned 32-bit division and returns the quotient and remainder as a pair. For divisors above 65535 it uses a 16-step shift-and-subtract loop, and for smaller divisors it divides the high and low halves separately.

name: shift_subtract_divide_loop
description: Runs a 16-step shift-and-subtract division loop on register values and leaves the quotient and remainder in registers. No value is returned to a caller.

name: multiply_32_bit_low_product
description: Multiplies two 32-bit register values using 16-bit partial products and returns the low 32 bits of the product. It also returns the second input with its two 16-bit halves swapped.

name: call_library_formatter_routine
description: Calls the library's formatted output routine through a library base held in a global variable, using the arguments already set up, and then returns.

name: store_byte_through_pointer
description: Stores the low byte of the data register at the address held in the A3 register and returns.

name: measure_string_length
description: Counts the characters in a null-terminated string and returns the count, not including the terminator.

name: find_char_in_string
description: Scans a null-terminated string for a given character and returns a pointer to its first occurrence, or null if the character is not found before the terminator.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns zero with no other work. It is a stub that reports failure to its callers.

name: copy_string_including_terminator
description: Copies a null-terminated string from the second argument into the buffer given as the first argument, including the terminating zero byte.

name: append_string_to_end
description: Finds the terminator of the first string and copies the second string onto its end, including the terminating zero byte.

name: compare_strings_up_to_count
description: Compares two strings for at most a given number of characters. It returns zero when they match over that span and one when they differ.

name: return_one_stub
description: Returns one with no other work. It is a stub that reports success to its callers.

name: walk_string_up_to_count
description: Walks a string for at most a given number of characters. If it reaches the terminating zero within that limit, it calls another routine before returning.

name: call_helper_then_return
description: Calls one other routine and then returns. The pseudo-code shows no other work, and the callee is not named in the executable.

name: copy_string_padded_to_count
description: Copies a string into a buffer of a given length, stopping after the terminator, and then zero-fills the rest of the buffer. It returns nothing.

name: initialise_empty_list_header
description: Initialises a list header in place: its head pointer is set to the entry just after the header, its tail is cleared, and its tail-predecessor points back to the header itself. It leaves the list empty.

name: run_record_setup_chain
description: A null argument returns one. Otherwise it calls one routine with a 20-byte size, and on success calls two more routines and a third that reads a field of the argument, returning the final result, or zero if the first call fails.

name: process_entry_list_until_end
description: Walks a linked list of entries, calling a helper on each entry's header and then a second helper on its data block, sized from a byte field. It returns one when the list ends and zero when a step fails.

name: walk_linked_entries_with_two_checks
description: Walks a linked list of entries and runs two helper routines on each one, stopping with zero when either helper fails. It returns one once the last entry has passed both checks.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns zero with no other work. It is a stub that reports failure to its callers.

name: allocate_entry_with_data_block
description: Allocates a 20-byte cleared entry, initialises it through a helper, then allocates a second block whose size comes from another helper and stores it in the entry. It returns the entry on success, zero when the argument is zero, and minus one when a step fails.

name: return_minus_one_stub
description: Returns minus one with no other work. It is a stub that signals failure to its callers.

name: build_entry_list_from_count
description: Builds a linked list of 16-byte cleared entries for a given count, linking each new entry to the previous one and allocating a data block for each. It returns the first entry when the count is used up, or minus one if an allocation or helper step fails.

name: build_entry_list_until_end
description: Builds a linked list of entries by repeatedly allocating an entry, linking it to the previous one and allocating a data block for it. It returns the first entry once the chain ends, or minus one when a step fails.

name: build_nested_entry_list
description: Builds a linked list of entries in nested loops, linking each new entry to the previous one and allocating a data block for each. It returns the first entry when the chain ends, or minus one if any allocation or helper step fails.

name: return_minus_one_stub
description: Returns minus one with no other work. It is a stub that signals failure to its callers.

name: stub_unimplemented_halt
description: The decompiler shows only an unimplemented-halt marker, so no behaviour can be recovered. It is a one-instruction stub at the start of the library file.

name: store_library_context_globals
description: Stores the frame pointer and the D0 register into two global variables, copies the A0 register into a third global, and writes it into a field of the structure addressed by the D0 register. It then returns.

name: call_helper_then_return
description: Calls one other routine and then returns. The pseudo-code shows no other work, and the callee is not named in the executable.

name: call_helper_then_return
description: Calls one other routine and then returns. The pseudo-code shows no other work, and the callee is not named in the executable.

name: call_helper_then_return
description: Calls one other routine and then returns. The pseudo-code shows no other work, and the callee is not named in the executable.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without any work, so it is an empty routine.

name: call_helper_then_return
description: Calls one other routine and then returns. The pseudo-code shows no other work, and the callee is not named in the executable.

name: clear_flag_and_increment_count
description: Clears one flag bit in a byte field of a structure, increments a 16-bit counter field, and returns the structure. It is a small bookkeeping step.

name: release_block_or_mark_pending
description: Reads a saved global value. When the structure's counter field is zero it passes the start and size of the structure's block, computed from two 16-bit fields, to a helper; otherwise it sets a pending flag bit, calls a helper and returns zero.

name: release_structure_block_returning_global
description: Passes the start and size of a structure's block, computed from two 16-bit fields, to a helper and then calls a second helper. It returns a global value that was saved on entry.

name: decrement_counter_and_finish
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter in a structure and, when it reaches zero with the pending flag bit set, calls a finishing routine and returns its result. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: release_info_globals_if_set
description: Releases each of several global pointers that are non-null, passing the non-null argument and a flag for the second argument where needed. It is a cleanup routine that returns nothing.

name: allocate_info_state_block
description: Allocates a cleared 944-byte state block and stores pointers to its sub-structures in global variables. It copies default data from a global template into several sub-structures, links some of them together, and returns one on success or zero when the allocation fails.

name: initialise_info_state_from_block
description: Fills in the pointers to the sub-structures of an existing state block and stores them in global variables. It copies default data from a global template into several sub-structures, links some together, and returns one.

name: open_dependency_libraries_or_fail
description: Opens four dependencies in order through a helper that takes a name string and a version of zero. If any open fails it records a distinct failure code, calls a cleanup routine with that code, and returns zero; it returns one when all four succeed.

name: open_three_dependencies_or_fail
description: Opens three dependencies in order through a helper passed in a register, using a name string and version zero. If any open fails it records a distinct failure code and calls a cleanup routine with that code; it returns one when all three succeed and zero otherwise.

name: open_two_dependencies_or_fail
description: Opens two dependencies in order through a helper that takes a name string and a version of zero, referencing the intuition library text. If either open fails it records a distinct failure code, calls a cleanup routine with that code, and returns zero; it returns one when both succeed.

name: open_graphics_library_or_fail
description: Opens the graphics library through a helper with a name string and version zero, and stores the handle in a global variable. If the open fails it calls a cleanup routine with failure code five and returns zero; otherwise it returns one.

name: return_one_stub
description: Returns one with no other work. It is a stub that reports success to its callers.

name: get_info_pointer_from_global_record
description: Looks up a record held in a global variable and returns its cached pointer field if that field is set. Otherwise it follows a link chosen by a type byte and returns a value from the record it reaches, or zero when the record is missing or of an excluded type.

name: get_info_pointer_from_argument_record
description: Reads a record passed in the A1 register and returns its cached pointer field if that field is set. Otherwise it follows a link chosen by a type byte and returns a value from the record it reaches, or zero when the record is missing or of an excluded type.

name: get_info_value_from_argument
description: Returns the cached pointer field of a record passed in the A1 register if it is set. Otherwise it follows a type-selected link to another record and returns a value from it, or zero when no link exists.

name: get_info_value_by_type_link
description: Returns a value from a record reached through a link chosen by a type byte in the argument record. The argument's own link is used for one type, and a second record is used otherwise, with zero returned when that second record is missing.

name: get_value_from_linked_record
description: Returns zero when the record passed in is null, and otherwise returns a value from the record linked at a fixed field of it.

name: lookup_disk_info_name
description: Builds a name in a 116-byte stack buffer from a stored name or a default text and looks it up through a helper using a sentinel argument. If the lookup finds nothing and the record is of the first type, it returns a value from the linked record and sets a flag.

name: lookup_name_from_record_field
description: Builds a name in a 116-byte stack buffer from a field of a record and looks it up through a helper using a sentinel argument. If the lookup finds nothing and the record is of the first type, it returns a value from the linked record and sets a flag.

name: allocate_info_buffers_and_fill
description: Allocates a 36-byte block and a 260-byte block, after checking two conditional helper results. It then allocates a data block of at least 256 bytes, sized from a global field, and fills in fields from globals; it returns one on success and zero when a check or allocation fails.

name: allocate_info_data_block_and_fill
description: Checks two conditional helper results, then allocates a data block of at least 256 bytes sized from a global field and fills in fields from globals. It returns one on success and zero when a check or allocation fails.

name: allocate_info_data_block_checked
description: Checks two conditional helper results, then allocates a data block of at least 256 bytes sized from a global field and fills in fields from globals. It returns one on success and zero when a check or the allocation fails.

name: allocate_info_block_optional_check
description: Runs an optional helper check, then allocates a data block of at least 256 bytes sized from a global field and fills in fields from globals. It returns one on success and zero when the check or allocation fails.

name: fill_info_data_block_unchecked
description: Allocates a data block of at least 256 bytes sized from a global field, fills in fields from globals, and returns whether the allocation succeeded. It performs no conditional checks first.

name: finish_info_block_fill
description: Copies two fields from globals into an existing data block and returns one. It is the final step after a block has been allocated and filled.

name: setup_info_library_state
description: Clears the info library's global handles and stores the context argument. It then allocates a 246-byte record and runs a chain of helper steps to set up the state; on any failure it records a distinct failure code and calls a cleanup routine with that code, and on success it finishes the setup.

name: setup_info_record_from_frame
description: Allocates a 246-byte record and runs the same chain of helper steps as the state setup routine, using a handle held in the stack frame. On any failure it records a distinct failure code and calls a cleanup routine with that code; on success it finishes the setup.

name: continue_info_record_setup
description: Continues the chain of setup steps for a record held in a register, using a handle in the stack frame. On any failure it records a distinct failure code and calls a cleanup routine with that code, and on success it finishes the setup.

name: finish_info_setup_from_handle
description: Runs the later setup steps on a handle held in a register and a stack-frame buffer, then finishes the setup. On a failure it records a distinct failure code and calls a cleanup routine with that code.

name: continue_info_setup_with_lookup
description: Looks up a global object and stores it through a register pointer, then runs the later setup steps on a stack-frame handle. On failure it records a distinct failure code and calls a cleanup routine with that code; on success it finishes the setup.

name: run_info_setup_tail
description: Runs the final setup steps on a stack-frame handle and a buffer, then reports success or failure to a completion routine using code zero or one. It releases an optional handle first when a global flag is clear.

name: complete_info_setup_or_fail
description: Releases an optional handle when a global flag is clear, then reports success or failure to a completion routine using code zero or one. Success depends on the result of a helper that checks the frame-local handle.

name: release_info_setup_handles
description: Releases the setup handles, including an optional extra handle when a global flag is clear and the argument is set, and then reports success to a completion routine.

name: forward_to_library_vector_132
description: Calls a library function through the library base stored in a global variable at a fixed negative vector offset, then returns without using the result.

name: forward_to_library_vector_138
description: Calls a library function through the library base stored in a global variable at a fixed negative vector offset, then returns without using the result.

name: forward_to_library_vector_198
description: Calls a library function through the library base stored in a global variable at a fixed negative vector offset, then returns without using the result.

name: forward_to_library_vector_210
description: Calls the library function at vector offset 210 through the library base held in a global variable, then returns without using the result.

name: forward_to_library_vector_246
description: Calls the library function at vector offset 246 through the library base held in a global variable, then returns without using the result.

name: open_info_release_window
description: Fills a window definition with a fixed position, size, pen and event settings, and points its title at the referenced version text. It opens the window through a library call and, when that succeeds, calls a second library routine with the handle, then returns the handle or zero.

name: dispatch_info_event_code
description: Dispatches on a 16-bit code stored in a record and calls a helper with arguments chosen for that code. It returns zero or one according to the case, and returns one for codes with no specific case.

name: return_one_stub
description: Returns one with no other work. It is a stub that reports success to its callers.

name: toggle_state_flag_for_code
description: Maps a 16-bit code in the second argument to one bit value and toggles that bit in a state word of the info record. Codes outside the table leave the state unchanged, and a helper is then called with a field of the first argument.

name: store_state_word_and_notify
description: Stores the D1 register value into a state word of the info record, then passes a field of the argument record to a helper.

name: build_info_path_and_check
description: Builds a file name from a path and a name with the info suffix and runs it through library lookups. It then updates state flags and returns true only when the lookups and flag checks all succeed.

name: check_disk_info_name
description: Builds a name in a 40-byte stack buffer from a record field or a global text and checks it with a helper. It then runs the same validity checks as the info path routine and returns one when they all pass, or zero otherwise.

name: validate_info_name_checks
description: Builds a name in a 40-byte stack buffer and runs a sequence of checks through helpers. It returns one only when all of the checks pass and zero otherwise.

name: check_four_entries_then_finish
description: Calls a helper four times with different table entries, returning zero if any call returns minus one. If all four succeed it calls a finishing routine and returns one.

name: check_three_calls_then_finish
description: Calls a function pointer three times and returns zero if any call returns minus one. Otherwise it calls a finishing routine and returns one.

name: check_two_calls_then_finish
description: Calls a function pointer twice and returns zero if either call returns minus one. Otherwise it calls a finishing routine and returns one.

name: call_and_finish_on_success
description: Calls a function pointer and, if it does not return minus one, calls a finishing routine. It returns true when that call succeeded.

name: finish_then_return_one
description: Calls one other routine and then returns one.

name: layout_info_window_columns
description: Places the column labels NAME, STATUS and TYPE, along with their fields and a block of related items, by making a series of helper calls. Each call uses a set of coordinate ranges for one element, and the routine returns nothing.

name: place_info_window_items_group_a
description: Makes seven helper calls that place a group of window items using coordinate ranges. It returns nothing.

name: place_info_window_items_group_b
description: Makes seven helper calls with a leading flag and coordinate ranges to place another group of window items. It returns nothing.

name: place_info_window_items_group_c
description: Makes nine helper calls with coordinate ranges to place a further group of window items. It returns nothing.

name: place_info_window_items_group_d
description: Makes nine helper calls with coordinate ranges to place a further group of window items. It returns nothing.

name: place_info_list_row
description: Chooses a vertical size for a row from a state byte and places either a placeholder row or the current list entry using coordinate values. When the second argument is nonzero it also places a header item.

name: place_info_list_empty_or_entry
description: Places an empty-list marker when the info list has no entries, otherwise places the current list entry. It then places an additional item when its flag argument is nonzero.

name: place_info_list_entry_with_flag
description: Places the current list entry through library calls and then places an additional item when its flag argument is nonzero.

name: build_info_entry_list_from_table
description: Allocates a list header node and links it into the info record, then for each entry of a null-terminated table allocates a 14-byte node with a 128-byte data block and adds it to the list. It returns zero when an allocation fails.

name: extend_info_entry_list_from_table
description: Links a new header node into the info record's list and then adds a node with a data block for each entry of a null-terminated table. It stops early when a node allocation fails.

name: add_table_entries_to_info_list
description: Allocates a node and a data block for each entry of a null-terminated table, copies the entry in, adds the node to the list and sets the list tail. It returns zero when a node allocation fails.

name: add_next_table_entry_to_list
description: Adds one table entry to the list by allocating a node and copying the entry into its data block. It repeats while further table entries remain and sets the list tail when the table ends.

name: place_or_advance_info_list_tail
description: Checks whether the info list's tail is at an end position. If it is, it places the list end item with a flag; otherwise it places the previous tail entry and moves the tail to the next node, then places the current entry.

name: retreat_info_list_cursor
description: Places the entry at the list cursor, moves the cursor to the node before it, and places a follow-up item. It returns nothing.

name: step_info_list_cursor_forward
description: If the cursor is at either end of the info list, places the list end marker. Otherwise it places the entry at the cursor, moves the cursor to the next node, and places a follow-up item.

name: advance_info_list_cursor
description: Places the entry at the list cursor, moves the cursor to the node after it, and places a follow-up item. It returns nothing.

name: insert_info_list_entry_at_cursor
description: Sets the list-changed flag and places the cursor entry if the list is not empty. It then allocates a 14-byte node with a 128-byte data block, inserts it at the cursor, makes it the new cursor, and places an item.

name: remove_info_list_entry_at_cursor
description: Sets the list-changed flag, places the entry at the cursor, and unlinks that node from the list. It then moves the cursor to a neighbouring node and places a follow-up item.

name: update_cursor_after_list_removal
description: Passes the cursor entry to a helper, then sets the cursor to the entry it reaches, or to the list head when the list is empty. It then places a follow-up item.

name: place_info_entry_fields
description: Places a fixed item and then two items taken from fields of the record in the A2 register.

name: build_info_entry_pointer_table
description: When the info list has changed, rebuilds a pointer table. It counts the list entries, allocates a cleared table with one slot per entry, and allocates a block for each entry. It returns one on success and zero when an allocation fails.

name: rebuild_info_entry_pointer_table
description: Rebuilds the info list's pointer table by counting the entries, allocating a cleared table with one slot per entry, and allocating a block for each entry. It clears the table and returns one when the list is empty, and returns zero when an allocation fails.

name: place_and_rebuild_info_entry_table
description: Places the cursor entry and then rebuilds the info list's pointer table, counting the entries, allocating a cleared table with one slot per entry, and allocating a block for each entry. It returns one on success and zero when an allocation fails.

name: build_entry_table_from_name_array
description: Counts a null-terminated array of pointers and allocates a cleared table with one slot for each pointer. It then allocates a block for each list entry and returns one on success or zero when an allocation fails.

name: fill_info_entry_table
description: Copies the list entries into an already allocated pointer table, allocating a block for each entry. It returns one when every entry is stored and zero when an allocation fails.

name: fill_entry_table_from_node
description: Walks the info list from a starting node, allocating a block for each entry and storing it in the next table slot. It returns one at the end of the list and zero when an allocation fails.

name: continue_entry_table_fill
description: Continues filling the pointer table from the current node, allocating a block for each remaining entry. It returns one at the end of the list and zero when an allocation fails.

name: layout_info_window_for_mode
description: Chooses one of six layouts from a mode byte in the info record and places the matching labels, fields and buttons using coordinate arguments. Each layout is a fixed sequence of placement calls, and the routine returns nothing.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without any work, so it is an empty routine.

name: allocate_info_layout_buffers
description: Allocates a first group of cleared buffers and, only if all of them succeed, a second group. It then places a layout chosen by a type byte and returns the result of a final helper; it returns zero when an allocation fails, and returns the type byte when that type is not handled.

name: place_info_layout_by_type
description: Calls a function pointer three times to gather handles and a value, returning zero if any of them is missing. Otherwise it runs a placement sequence chosen by a type byte and returns the result of the final helper.

name: place_info_items_by_type
description: Runs a fixed number of placement helpers chosen by a type byte, with two to five calls depending on the type. It returns nothing.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without any work, so it is an empty routine.

name: place_info_status_text_or_clear
description: Clears a status word or copies a stored value into a text buffer, then places an item. It returns the placement result, or zero when that result is minus one.

name: place_info_status_text_value
description: Passes a stored value to a helper, then places the resulting item and returns its result, or zero when the placement returns minus one.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without any work, so it is an empty routine.

name: place_info_footer_items
description: Sets vertical positions in four item records unless the type byte is four, then places all four items. It returns one when every placement succeeds and zero when any placement fails.
